verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents an official MCP server. A probe confirmed the dedicated docs page at developers.heygen.com/mcp/overview, and the docs say every endpoint ships with an MCP server so Claude, Cursor and custom agents can generate video. The llms.txt adds that any MCP-compatible agent can connect with no API keys, no local server and no separate credits. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection working, and detailed evidence of the exposed tool set and auth/setup flow.
